summary: Phase 9 MANDATORY PROBE GATE, dispatch 2 of 3 (hard cap). Wrote probes/theta_place_layered.lean (scratch, outside Cslib/) redesigning place to recurse into disjunction -- place(x,P-or-Q) := place(x,P) or place(x,Q) by rfl, flat boxIter otherwise -- keeping Theta completely unchanged (still sigAt+orphanFacts, target-independent). Re-validated ALL FIVE adversarial gate cases. RESULT: A, B, C, E all PASS unaffected (place only diverges from dispatch 1 at depth >= 1 on or-headed formulas; these four cases are all depth-0). Case D: caseD_orE_core_layered closes the exact orE-at-depth-1 core step with ZERO bridge, using only place's or-recursion (rfl) + dispatch 1's already-valid inject (box_and_intro) + the plain Hilbert orE axiom -- PROVIDED the major premise's own translation (hOr) is available in split form. Machine-checked (hOr_split_from_orI1) that this holds for free whenever the disjunction arose via orI1/orI2. HONEST RESIDUAL, also machine-checked (hOr_split_needs_bridge_from_flat, non-vacuous per place_ht2_c2_atom): if the disjunction instead arose via the ASSUMPTION rule (Gamma literally asserts a compound fact y:(A-or-B)), sigAt's fixed Preserved-Asset structure can only ever deliver the flat boxed form there, and reaching split form from flat form still needs the exact same non-theorem bridge as dispatch 1. NET: dispatch 1's blanket finding (orE always needs the bridge) is REFUTED; the obstruction narrows to a precisely localized, Phase-13-scoped question (does cs5_completeness's canonical construction ever hand nik_adequacy a context with a literally-compound assumption?) that this dispatch did not investigate (out of Phase 9's shape-validation remit, would require reading the canonical-model construction not the Theta/place translation). OVERALL GATE VERDICT: CONDITIONAL PASS on case D (not an unconditional PASS), A/B/C/E unconditional PASS. Cslib/ was not touched by this dispatch (verified via git status --short Cslib/ before and after commit); a concurrent, unrelated agent's edit to Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/LoopChecking.lean was neither staged nor committed by this dispatch.

blockers.description: orE core step closes cleanly with the layered (recursive-over-or) place redesign, with zero bridge, WHENEVER the major premise's disjunctive translation (hOr) is available in split form (place(c2,A) or place(c2,B) rather than the flat place(c2,A-or-B)). This holds for free when the disjunction was introduced via orI1/orI2. The residual: if a context Gamma ever asserts a compound (disjunctive) fact directly via the assumption rule, sigAt's fixed recursive structure (a Preserved Asset, cannot be changed under the plan's postmortem constraints) can only ever produce the flat boxed form for that sub-case, and converting flat to split still needs the same non-theorem bridge dispatch 1 found.

Provable ONLY given bridge (rw [hAeq,hBeq]; exact cs5_deriv_imp_trans hOrFlat bridge) -- no route avoiding bridge was found for this specific sub-case (same non-theorem as dispatch 1, now localized to exactly the assumption-of-compound-fact scenario rather than orE generally).
blockers.what_was_tried: Redefined place to recurse into `.or` (place(x,P-or-Q) := place(x,P).or(place(x,Q)) by rfl); re-derived the orE core step (caseD_orE_core_layered) using this shape, closing cleanly for the orI1/orI2-originated sub-case (hOr_split_from_orI1, zero extra hypotheses); confirmed via hOr_split_needs_bridge_from_flat that the SAME bridge non-theorem resurfaces if the disjunction instead reaches place via a literal context-assumption of a compound fact translated through the FIXED, Preserved-Asset sigAt structure (which cannot be redesigned to split disjunctive facts without violating the plan's 'Do NOT touch or re-derive any Preserved Asset row' constraint).
blockers.root_cause: sigAt's recursive per-depth boxing (Preserved Asset, immutable) boxes factsAt(y) WHOLESALE regardless of a fact's own top connective; a raw disjunctive context assumption is therefore forced through sigAt's flat boxing with no opportunity to split. place's own or-recursion only ever sees a disjunction AT THE POINT place is applied to a target formula (e.g. after orI1/orI2 introduction), not retroactively inside sigAt's context-fact folding.

If never possible: case D becomes an unconditional PASS with no further place redesign, and Phase 9 can close cleanly. If possible: Phase 13/16 must carry the orI1/orI2-vs-assumption case split through explicitly (e.g. a context well-formedness invariant restricting compound assumptions, or routing that one sub-case to Phase 23).

decisions_made: Kept Theta(G,Gamma,root) := sigAt G Gamma hfin root AND bigAndL(orphanFacts G Gamma root) completely unchanged from dispatch 1 -- no redesign needed there; the Case-D obstruction lives entirely in place's shape, not Theta's.

Redefined place to recurse structurally into Proposition.or: place(ht,x,P.or Q) := (place ht x P).or (place ht x Q), by rfl; place(ht,x,A) := boxIter (ht x) A otherwise (unchanged fallback). This is a genuine redefinition of place (not merely a restated hypothesis), so the split form of a disjunctive target's translation is available BY CONSTRUCTION whenever the translation is built via place directly (e.g. from an orI1/orI2 introduction), not merely assumed.

Chose to write a NEW probe file (theta_place_layered.lean) rather than editing dispatch 1's probe in place, per the plan's own 'or a new probe file' dispatch-2 direction; dispatch 1's probe is preserved unmodified as an artifact.

Reported the true, honest outcome (CONDITIONAL PASS with a precisely localized residual) rather than rounding to PASS or FAIL, per the hard-mode instruction against weakening a statement to force a case to pass. The residual is narrower and more precisely diagnosed than dispatch 1's blanket bridge-need finding, which is itself a valid, reportable form of progress.

Did not investigate cs5_completeness's canonical-model construction (Phase-13-scoped, out of Phase 9's shape-validation remit) to resolve whether the assumption-rule residual is actually reachable; flagged explicitly as the natural next step rather than guessed at.
dead_ends: Considered making place's or-recursion also reach INTO sigAt's own recursive definition (to split compound context-fact assumptions at the source) -- rejected: sigAt/factsAt/bigAndL are Preserved Assets, 'REUSED VERBATIM' per the plan and 'Do NOT touch or re-derive any Preserved Asset row' per the postmortem constraints; redefining sigAt's recursion would violate this.

Considered a K-necessitation-of-closed-orE-schema route (deriving box(A implies D) and box(B implies D) and box(A-or-B) implies box D via necessitating the closed propositional orE tautology plus the K axiom, entirely bridge-free) as an alternative combination mechanism -- analysis showed the branch hypotheses naturally available from inject are shaped box A implies D (box on the antecedent alone), not box(A implies D) (box on the whole implication), and these two shapes are logically incomparable in K (converting one to the other would itself need hypothesis-level necessitation, the same non-theorem already flagged unavailable in dispatch 1). Abandoned in favor of the simpler, cleaner or-recursive place redesign, which sidesteps this incomparability entirely by never forming the flat box(A-or-B) as the orI1/orI2 route's translation in the first place.
